sentences.en: He doesn't want to answer any of my legitimate questions.
sentences.zh: 他不想回答我提出的任何合理问题。

sentences.en: We consider it the citizens' legitimate right to have public libraries.
sentences.zh: 我们认为公民有权享受公共图书馆服务。

sentences.en: The Mafia uses legitimate business operations as a front.
sentences.zh: 黑帮利用合法的企业活动作为掩护。

senses.zh: 合法的；正当的；合理的；正统的

mnemonic: 词根记忆：leg（法律）+itim+ate（使…） →（使）合法legitimately adv. 合情合理地
